description: The file manages a registry of Discord GatewayPlugin instances, providing functions to register, unregister, retrieve, and clear gateways. It acts as a bridge between REST handlers and WebSocket operations. It includes internal mapping and utility functions for account key resolution.

methods.description: Unregisters the GatewayPlugin associated with the given account ID.
